approved: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill would repeal Australia's Net Zero policy, its targets, and related legislation.
It would remove the policy by amending or repealing the Acts listed in the bill's schedules.
The bill would commence the day after it receives Royal Assent.
Repeals the Net Zero policy and its associated targets.
Repeals supporting legislation listed in the bill's schedules.
Commences the day after Royal Assent.
The explanatory memorandum says the bill would affect the Australian economy and cost of living, but does not specify which people, businesses, or agencies are directly affected.
